title: Co-translational binding of importins to nascent proteins
authors: Seidel M; Romanov N; Obarska-Kosinska A; Becker A; de Azevedo NTD; Provaznik J; Nagaraja SR; Landry JJM; Benes V; Beck M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究importins与新生蛋白的共翻译结合，属于蛋白质-蛋白质互作，不涉及DNA，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
Various cellular quality control mechanisms support proteostasis. While, ribosome-associated chaperones prevent misfolding of nascent chains during translation, importins were shown to prevent the aggregation of specific cargoes in a post-translational mechanism prior the import into the nucleoplasm. Here, we hypothesized that importins may already bind ribosome-associated cargo in a co-translational manner. We systematically measured the nascent chain association of all importins in Saccharomyces cerevisiae by selective ribosome profiling. We identified a subset of importins that bind to a wide range of nascent, often uncharacterized cargoes. This included ribosomal proteins, chromatin remodelers and RNA binding proteins that are aggregation prone in the cytosol. We show that importins act consecutively with other ribosome-associated chaperones. Thus, the nuclear import system is directly intertwined with nascent chain folding and chaperoning.

One-Sentence Summary

We describe an unanticipated connection between co-translational protein chaperoning and the nuclear import system.
abstract_zh: 多种细胞质量控制机制支持蛋白质稳态。在翻译过程中，核糖体相关伴侣蛋白防止新生链错误折叠，而输入蛋白（importins）则被证明在进入核质之前，通过翻译后机制防止特定货物蛋白的聚集。在此，我们假设输入蛋白可能以共翻译方式结合核糖体相关货物。我们通过选择性核糖体分析（selective ribosome profiling）系统测量了酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中所有输入蛋白的新生链关联。我们识别出一组输入蛋白，它们与广泛的新生货物结合，这些货物通常未被表征，包括核糖体蛋白、染色质重塑因子和RNA结合蛋白，这些蛋白在细胞质中易于聚集。我们表明，输入蛋白与其他核糖体相关伴侣蛋白连续作用。因此，核输入系统与新生链折叠和伴侣功能直接交织在一起。 < h4>一句话总结 我们描述了共翻译蛋白伴侣功能与核输入系统之间一个未曾预料的联系。
